acceptance: Native phase names every required category with an observed record or explicit missing/stale/not_scheduled status.
Point-in-time decisions use only data demonstrably available by decision time.
Next phase links predecessor and appends changes, preserving original snapshots.
Any strategy use requires separate preregistration and real execution evidence; contextual observation is not a verified edge.
